  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 3:32 PM, Vice Chair de Armas called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Baca, Callihan, Chiddick, Patterson, Woodman-Nance, Wheeler, de
Armas

Also present: Lea Eriksen, Director of Technology and Innovation, Alejandra Garcia, Executive
Assistant, Adam Jacobs, Deputy City Attorney, Matthew Bunma, City Clerk Specialist.

ELECTION OF CHAIR

A motion was made by Commissioner Woodman-Nance, to elect Vice Chair de Armas for
Chair of the Technology and Innovation Commission. The motion carried by the following
vote:

Yes:  6  Baca, Callihan, Chiddick, Patterson, Woodman-Nance, Wheeler
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Abstain:  1  de Armas
Absent:  0  None

Commissioner Woodman-Nance spoke.

 Vice Chair de Armas declared the nominations open for Chair.

 Commissioner Woodman-Nance nominated Vice Chair de Armas as Chair of the Technology and
Innovation Commission.

 There being no further nominations, Vice Chair de Armas declared the nominations closed for Chair.

 Vice Chair de Armas accepted the Chair of the Technology and Innovation Commission nomination.
